categories.name: Good Morning Images
categories.intro: A little sunshine for someone’s day. Beautiful morning wishes to download, share, or make your own.
categories.card: Sunrise, flowers and tea to start someone’s day
categories.title: Good Morning Images for WhatsApp, Free
categories.description: Original good morning images with flowers, sunrise and tea, in English, Malayalam and Hindi. Download free, or put your own words on one first.
categories.answer: These are original good morning images you can download and send on WhatsApp for free, with no sign-up. There are 18, each a square 1080 × 1080 picture with the greeting set as real text, in English, Malayalam (സുപ്രഭാതം) or Hindi (सुप्रभात): flowers, sunrises over hills and backwaters, tea, and a few with a blessing or a Bible verse. Tap a picture to open it, then download it as it is or type your own words onto it first.

sections.heading: Choosing a morning picture for the person you are sending it to
body: A good morning message lands differently depending on who opens it. For a parent or an older relative, a greeting in their own language reads as more personal than an English one: the Malayalam pictures say സുപ്രഭാതം or ശുഭദിനം, and two are addressed to a parent directly: സുപ്രഭാതം അമ്മേ and സുപ്രഭാതം അച്ഛാ. For a family or office group, a plain “Good morning” over flowers or a sunrise is the safe choice, because nobody is left out.

If the group is a church or prayer group, the verse picture (“This is the day the Lord has made”, Psalm 118:24) fits better than a general greeting. For one close friend, the shorter lines such as “Hello, sunshine.” or “Start with kindness.” feel less like a forward.

sections.heading: Why the Malayalam and Hindi letters come out right
body: Many forwarded good morning images have blurred text, and Malayalam or Hindi letters are often broken because the wording was drawn by an image tool that does not know the script. Here the artwork and the words are separate: the greeting is typeset as real text and then saved at 1080 × 1080. The joined letters in സുപ്രഭാതം and सुप्रभात are formed correctly, and the line stays readable at chat-preview size.

sections.heading: Putting your own greeting on a morning picture
body: Open any picture and use “Add a name or message”. What you type replaces the wording on the picture, so write the whole line you want, for example “Good morning, Amma”, up to 120 characters. Then press Download to save a 1080 × 1080 PNG, or Share to send it from your phone.

faq.q: Are these good morning images free to use?
faq.a: Yes. Every picture here is free to download and share, and you do not need an account.

faq.q: Can I add a name to a good morning image?
faq.a: Yes. Open the picture and type your line under “Add a name or message”. It replaces the greeting on the picture, so write the full line, such as “Good morning, Amma”, and not only the name.

faq.q: Do you have good morning images in Malayalam and Hindi?
faq.a: Yes. Use the language filter above the gallery to see only Malayalam or only Hindi pictures. The Malayalam pictures say സുപ്രഭാതം or ശുഭദിനം, and the Hindi pictures say सुप्रभात, set as real text so the letters are formed correctly.

faq.q: What size are the good morning images?
faq.a: Each image is a square, 1080 × 1080 pixels. The plain download is a JPG. If you add your own words, the download is a PNG at the same size.

faq.q: How do I send one on WhatsApp?
faq.a: On a phone, press Share on the picture and choose WhatsApp if your browser offers it. If it does not, press Download and attach the saved picture in the chat.

categories.name: WhatsApp DP
categories.intro: A little picture. A lot of personality. Find your next profile picture.
categories.card: Profile pictures for every mood and moment
categories.title: DP for WhatsApp: Friends, Couple & Islamic
categories.description: Square DPs for WhatsApp profiles and group icons: friends, couple and Islamic pictures. Free to download, or type your own words on one first.
categories.answer: A DP is the display picture on your WhatsApp profile or group. The pictures here are square, 1080 × 1080, free to download, and sorted into friends group DPs, couple DPs and Islamic DPs. Open one to save it as it is, or replace the wording with your own before you download.

sections.heading: What makes a picture work as a DP
body: WhatsApp shows a profile picture inside a small circle, so the corners of a square image are cut off and everything is seen at thumbnail size. A picture works as a DP when the subject sits in the middle and any words are few and large. A long quote becomes unreadable at that size; three or four words survive.

sections.heading: Profile DP or group icon?
body: Your own profile picture says something about you, so couple and faith pictures belong there. A group icon speaks for everyone in the group, which is why a friends picture with a shared line such as “Our kind of crazy.” suits it better.
In a group, admins can always change the icon. Other members can change it only if the group allows all participants to edit the group info.

faq.q: What size should a WhatsApp DP be?
faq.a: Use a square picture, because WhatsApp shows the DP as a circle cut from the middle. The pictures here are 1080 × 1080 pixels.

faq.q: Will the words on the picture be cut off in the circle?
faq.a: The ends of a line near the top or bottom edge can be. Keep your own text to a few words, and look at the DP after you set it. You can always come back and download a shorter version.

faq.q: Can I put my name on a DP?
faq.a: Yes. Open the picture and type under “Add a name or message”. Your text replaces the wording on the picture.

faq.q: Are these DPs free?
faq.a: Yes. They are free to download and use as a profile picture or group icon, with no sign-up.

faq.q: Do you have DPs in Malayalam, Hindi or Arabic?
faq.a: The ready-made DPs are in English for now. You can type your own line in Malayalam, Hindi, Arabic or any other language and it is set as real text on the picture.

categories.name: Friends Group DP
categories.intro: For your favourite people and your never-quiet group chat.
categories.card: Group icons for the chat that never sleeps
categories.title: Friends Group DP for WhatsApp Groups
categories.description: Friends group DPs for your WhatsApp group icon. Free square pictures you can download as they are, or put your group's name on first.
categories.answer: A friends group DP is the icon for your WhatsApp group, so it should stand for the whole gang and still read when it is tiny. There are 8 square pictures here, all free: friends seen from behind on hills and beaches, hands stacked together, sneakers in a circle and a campfire with a Malayalam line. Each has a short line you can keep or replace with your group's name.

sections.heading: A group icon is seen small, by everyone in the group
body: The icon appears beside the group's name in every member's chat list, at thumbnail size. A photo of the actual members dates quickly, and someone always dislikes how they look in it. None of the pictures here shows a face: the friends are seen from behind or as silhouettes against the sky, or stand in as hands and shoes, so any group can use them.

sections.heading: Using your group's name instead of the caption
body: The captions here are short on purpose: “Squad.”, “Better together.”, “Friends forever.” To make the icon yours, open a picture and type the group's name under “Add a name or message”, for example “School Gang 2005”. Your text replaces the caption. Two to four words stay readable inside the circle; a full sentence does not.

sections.heading: A friends group DP in Malayalam
body: One picture is in Malayalam: four friends round a campfire on a hill among coconut palms, with നമ്മുടെ സൗഹൃദം (our friendship) and എന്നും ഒരുമിച്ച് (always together) underneath. It suits a college or hometown group that chats in Malayalam, and you can type the group's own name in Malayalam in its place.

faq.q: Who can change a WhatsApp group icon?
faq.a: That depends on the group's settings. Admins can always change it. Other members can only if the group allows all participants to edit the group info.

faq.q: Can I write the group name in Malayalam or Hindi?
faq.a: Yes. Type it in any language and it is set as real text, so Malayalam, Hindi and Arabic letters are formed correctly.

faq.q: Will a friends DP work for a family or cousins group?
faq.a: Yes. Lines such as “Better together.” or “Our little gang.” work for cousins as well as friends. You can also type the family's name. Your text replaces both the caption and any small line under it, so put everything you want into the one line you type.

faq.q: What if the group name is cut off in the circle?
faq.a: WhatsApp cuts a circle out of the middle of a square picture, so the ends of a long line near the bottom can be lost. Shorten the name, download again, and set the new copy.

faq.q: Is there a DP for a girls' group?
faq.a: Yes. One picture shows three girls standing arm in arm on a beach at sunset, seen from behind, with “Our little gang.” Type your group's name to replace the line.

categories.name: Couple DP
categories.intro: Little pictures for a love that feels like home.
categories.card: Little pictures for the two of you
categories.title: Couple DP for WhatsApp, Free to Download
categories.description: Couple DPs for WhatsApp: romantic square pictures with a short line you can keep or replace with your own names or date. Free, no sign-up.
categories.answer: A couple DP is a profile picture that shows the two of you, or stands in for you, on WhatsApp. There are 10 here, all square and free, and none shows a face: couples seen from behind or as silhouettes, hands making a heart or wearing rings, and pairs of things such as two cups, two swings, two bicycles or two lovebirds. Each has a short line you can replace with your names or a date.

sections.heading: Why an illustrated couple DP instead of a photo
body: Not everyone wants their own photo, or their partner's, visible to every contact, colleague and family group. An illustration keeps the feeling and leaves your faces out. One picture here shows a couple from behind under a pink flowering tree, watching the sun set over the sea, so it reads as “us” without being anyone in particular.

sections.heading: Making the DP about the two of you
body: Open the picture and type under “Add a name or message”. Your text replaces the line on the picture, so write the full line: both names, a wedding date, or a few words only the two of you understand. Short lines survive best, because WhatsApp shows the DP in a small circle.
Some couples both set the same picture. Others each put the other's name on it. Either works, since every download is made from the text you typed.

sections.heading: Cute or romantic: choosing a couple DP
body: A cute couple DP is light and playful, like the two heart lattes with “Us.”; a romantic one is softer, like the sunset beach with “Forever yours.” Objects such as cups, swings or mugs work well at DP size, because they still read as two of something in a small circle.

faq.q: Can I add both our names to a couple DP?
faq.a: Yes. Type both names in one line, for example “Anu & Rahul”, and it replaces the wording on the picture. You have up to 120 characters, though a short line reads better at DP size.

faq.q: Can we both use the same couple DP?
faq.a: Yes. Download the picture on one phone and send it to the other, or open the same page on both phones and download it twice.

faq.q: Does the couple DP show faces?
faq.a: No. The couples are seen from behind or far away as silhouettes, and the other pictures show only hands, cups, swings, bicycles, birds or mugs, so nobody’s face is shown.

faq.q: Can I write the line in my own language?
faq.a: Yes. Whatever you type is set as real text, including Malayalam, Hindi and Arabic.

faq.q: Is there a couple DP without any people in it?
faq.a: Yes. Several show only a pair of things: two heart lattes, two empty swings, two bicycles side by side, two mugs by a rainy window and two lovebirds on a blossom branch.

categories.name: Islamic DP
categories.intro: Peaceful images and heartfelt wishes for moments of faith.
categories.card: Peaceful pictures for moments of faith
categories.title: Islamic DP for WhatsApp, Free to Download
categories.description: Islamic DPs for WhatsApp: a calm mosque picture with a short reminder of faith. Free to download, or replace the line with your own dua or greeting.
categories.answer: An Islamic DP is a profile picture that reflects your faith: a mosque, a crescent, a short reminder. The pictures here are free and square, with no people in them: a mosque beside still water with “Peace begins with faith.”, and a mosque at dusk with مساء الخير (good evening) in Arabic. You can keep the wording or replace it with your own.

sections.heading: A DP with no faces or figures
body: Many people choose an Islamic DP because they would rather not use a photo of themselves. Neither picture here has people in it. One shows a mosque with a green dome and tall minarets reflected in the water, with white blossom in the corners; the other shows a mosque in silhouette at dusk under a thin crescent moon.

sections.heading: Changing the wording, including Arabic
body: Open the picture and type under “Add a name or message”. Your line replaces the English text. Arabic is written right to left and the picture handles that: type السلام عليكم or a short dua and it is set as real Arabic text. For Ramadan, Eid or Jummah you can type the greeting you want and download a fresh copy each time.

faq.q: What does “Alhamdulillah” on the picture mean?
faq.a: It is Arabic for “praise be to God”, said in thanks. On the picture it appears as “Alhamdulillah, always.” under the main line.

faq.q: Can I write Arabic text on the DP?
faq.a: Yes. Type or paste the Arabic and it is set right to left as real text.

faq.q: Can I use it as a group icon or status too?
faq.a: Yes. It is a square 1080 × 1080 picture, so it works as a profile picture, as the icon for a family or mosque group, or as a status.

faq.q: Does the Islamic DP include any people?
faq.a: No. It shows only the mosque, the water, the sky and flowers.

categories.name: Christian Images
categories.intro: Start the day with gratitude, hope and a little blessing.
categories.card: Morning blessings and verses to share
categories.title: Christian Good Morning Images & Verses
categories.description: Christian good morning images with a Bible verse or blessing, free to share in your family or church WhatsApp group. Add your own verse first.
categories.answer: A Christian good morning image is a morning greeting built around a Bible verse or a short blessing. There are 11 here: verses from the Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, Lamentations and John set over sunrises, lakes and mountains, short blessings such as “God bless you” and “Have a blessed day”, and two pictures in Malayalam. They are free to download, and you can replace the words with your own.

sections.heading: Psalm 118:24 as a morning verse
body: The verse goes on: “let us rejoice and be glad in it.” It suits a morning message because it is about today, not about yesterday or what might come, which is what you want to say to someone at the start of their day.

sections.heading: Sending a verse picture to a church or family group
body: In a prayer group or church group, a verse picture says more than a plain “Good morning”. If your group follows a daily reading, open the picture, type that day's verse under “Add a name or message”, and download it. Put the reference in the line you type, because adding your own text removes the small reference line.
Verses in Malayalam or Hindi can be typed the same way and are set as real text.

sections.heading: A blessing instead of a verse
body: Not every morning message needs a full verse. A short line such as “God bless you”, “Jesus loves you” or “Have a blessed day” reads well at WhatsApp size and suits an older relative who forwards greetings every day. One Malayalam picture says ദൈവം അനുഗ്രഹിക്കട്ടെ, may God bless you, under സുപ്രഭാതം.

sections.heading: A Bible verse in Malayalam
body: One picture carries Psalm 118:24 in Malayalam, ഇതു യഹോവ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ദിവസം, over Kerala paddy fields at sunrise, with the reference സങ്കീർത്തനങ്ങൾ 118:24 underneath. For a family that reads the Malayalam Bible, a verse in its familiar words feels closer than an English one.

faq.q: Which Bible verses are on the pictures?
faq.a: Psalm 118:24 (in English and in Malayalam), Psalm 46:10, Lamentations 3:22–23 (a short form of the verse), Proverbs 3:5, Isaiah 40:31 and John 8:12. Each reference is printed in small text under the verse.

faq.q: Can I put a different verse on it?
faq.a: Yes. Type the verse under “Add a name or message” and it replaces the one on the picture. You have up to 120 characters, and longer verses are set smaller so they fit.

faq.q: Can I type the verse in Malayalam?
faq.a: Yes. Malayalam, Hindi and other scripts are set as real text, so the letters are formed correctly.

faq.q: Do these pictures also appear in the good morning gallery?
faq.a: Five do, including both Malayalam pictures. They also appear in the Good Morning Images gallery, alongside the general greetings. The others are only here.

categories.intro: Make their special day a little more wonderful.
categories.card: Wishes for their special day — add their name
categories.title: Birthday Wishes with Name, Free Image
categories.description: Make a birthday wish with their name on it: type your line onto a cake-and-balloons picture and download it free to send on WhatsApp.
categories.answer: To send a birthday wish with a name on it, open one of the birthday pictures here, type the wish including their name, and download it. There are 8 square 1080 × 1080 pictures: cakes, cupcakes, balloons, gifts and flowers, with greetings such as “Happy Birthday!”, “Happy Birthday, Amma.” and “Many happy returns of the day.”, and one in Malayalam. All are free and need no sign-up.

sections.heading: How the name goes on the birthday picture
body: Each picture starts with a birthday greeting and a small line underneath. When you type under “Add a name or message”, your text replaces both, so type the whole wish and not only the name: “Happy Birthday, Anu!” or “Happy 60th Birthday, Appa”. You have up to 120 characters, and a longer wish is set smaller so that it fits.

sections.heading: Getting the name right in any language
body: Names are where ready-made birthday images usually fail: the spelling is fixed, or the letters of a Malayalam or Hindi name come out broken. Here you type the name yourself, in the script the person actually uses, and it is set as real text. “ജന്മദിനാശംസകൾ, അമ്മേ” works as well as “Happy Birthday, Mom”.

sections.heading: One picture for every birthday in the family
body: In a family group where a birthday comes round every few weeks, you can come back to the same page, type a new name and download a new copy each time. There is no account and no limit.

sections.heading: Pictures already addressed to someone
body: Two pictures are already addressed: “Happy Birthday, Amma.” over a bouquet of roses and lilies with pastel balloons, and “Happy Birthday, dear friend.” over wrapped gifts and confetti. Keep the line as it is, or type the person's own name in its place.

faq.q: Can I write the birthday wish in Malayalam or Hindi?
faq.a: Yes. Type the wish in any language and it is set as real text on the picture.

faq.q: Can I add a photo of the person?
faq.a: Not yet. For now you can change the words on the picture, not the artwork.

faq.q: Is the name written on the cake?
faq.a: No. Nothing is written on the cakes, cupcakes, gifts or balloons; the wish with the name sits in the space above them.

faq.q: How long can the birthday wish be?
faq.a: Up to 120 characters. The text is set smaller as it gets longer, so a short wish is larger and easier to read.

faq.q: Does adding a name cost anything?
faq.a: No. Downloading and sharing is free, with or without a name added.

categories.name: Good Night Images
categories.intro: Send a little peace before the day comes to an end.
categories.card: A calm goodnight before the day ends
categories.title: Good Night Images for WhatsApp, Free
categories.description: Good night images for WhatsApp: starry skies, still lakes, Bible verses and Malayalam blessings, each with a short line. Free, or add your own words.
categories.answer: These are good night images to send on WhatsApp at the end of the day. There are 11, all free square 1080 × 1080 pictures: moonlit and starry skies over lakes, a harbour and Kerala homes, with lines such as “Good night, my love.” and “Good night, Amma.”, two Bible verses, and Malayalam pictures with ശുഭരാത്രി. You can replace the words with your own.

sections.heading: A good night message is usually for one person
body: A good night picture is often more personal than a good morning forward. It tends to go to one person: a parent living alone, a child away from home, a partner in another time zone. That is why these pictures are dark and still, with one short line, and why it is worth changing the wording to something you would actually say to that person.

sections.heading: Saying good night in your own words
body: Open the picture and type under “Add a name or message”. Your line replaces both lines on the picture. “Good night, Amma”, ശുഭരാത്രി or शुभ रात्रि are set as real text in the same pale lettering, on the same deep blue.

sections.heading: Good night blessings and verses
body: Some families end the day with a blessing rather than a plain good night. Some pictures carry one, such as “Good night. God bless you.” or “Sleep in God’s care.”; two carry a verse, Psalm 4:8 and Psalm 121:3; and one Kerala picture says ദൈവം കാത്തുരക്ഷിക്കട്ടെ, may God keep you safe.

faq.q: Can I write good night in Malayalam or Hindi?
faq.a: Yes. Type ശുഭരാത്രി, शुभ रात्रि or any other greeting and it is set as real text on the picture.

faq.q: What do the good night pictures say?
faq.a: Most say good night in a few words, some to a particular person (“Good night, my love.”, “Good night, Amma.”), some with a blessing (“Good night. God bless you.”), two with a Bible verse (Psalm 4:8 and Psalm 121:3), and two in Malayalam with ശുഭരാത്രി. Open a picture to see its full wording.

faq.q: Can I add a name to the good night image?
faq.a: Yes. Type the full line, such as “Good night, Achu”, because your text replaces the wording that is there.

faq.q: Can I post it as a WhatsApp status?
faq.a: Yes. It is a square 1080 × 1080 image and can be posted as a status like any other photo.

faq.q: Is there a good night image for Amma?
faq.a: Yes. One shows a tiled-roof Kerala house at night with an oil lamp lit at the door, and says “Good night, Amma.” Type Achan, Ammachi or any other name instead; your text replaces the line.

categories.name: Attitude DP
categories.intro: Be yourself. Let your picture do the talking.
categories.card: Bold DPs that say it for you
categories.title: Attitude DP for WhatsApp
categories.description: Attitude DPs for WhatsApp: bold square pictures with a short, confident line you can keep or replace with your own. Free, no sign-up.
categories.answer: An attitude DP is a profile picture that says something about you without a long status: a bold image and a few confident words. The ones here are free square pictures: a lion lit gold against black with “Born to stand out.”, and an eagle over dark mountains with “Rise above.” You can replace the line with your own.

sections.heading: What makes an attitude DP work at DP size
body: WhatsApp shows your DP as a small circle, so an attitude picture needs one strong subject, a dark or plain background and very few words. The lion picture follows that: the face fills the lower part of the frame and the line sits on clean black above it, where it stays readable.

sections.heading: Writing your own attitude line
body: Open the picture and type under “Add a name or message”. Your words replace the line on the picture and the one beneath it. Short and sharp works best: “Less talk. More action.”, a nickname, or a line in Malayalam or Hindi. Whatever you type is set as real text over the art.

faq.q: Can I download the attitude DP without signing up?
faq.a: Yes. Open the picture and download it as a 1080 × 1080 PNG. There is no account and no sign-up.

faq.q: Can I put my own line on the attitude DP?
faq.a: Yes. Type it under “Add a name or message” and it replaces the words on the picture. Up to 120 characters is allowed, but two to five words read best in the DP circle.

faq.q: Can I write my attitude line in Malayalam or Hindi?
faq.a: Yes. Malayalam, Hindi, Arabic and English are all set as real text, so the letters come out correctly instead of broken.

faq.q: Why do the attitude DPs show animals and not people?
faq.a: A lion or an eagle reads instantly at small sizes and does not show your face or anyone else’s, so it works if you would rather not post a photo of yourself.

categories.name: Motivational Images
categories.intro: A few words can make a world of difference.
categories.card: A few words to keep someone going
categories.title: Motivational Images with Quotes, Free
categories.description: Motivational images with a short quote, free to download and share. Or put your own quote on the picture and send it to someone who needs it.
categories.answer: Motivational images are short quotes set on a picture, made to be sent to someone who needs a push. The pictures here read “Small steps. Beautiful beginnings.” over a moonlit lake and “Keep climbing.” over a mountain trail at dawn. They are free to download at 1080 × 1080, and you can replace the quote with your own.

sections.heading: Short quotes are the ones that get read
body: A quote on a picture is read in a second or not at all. Two short sentences, like the ones here, can be taken in from the chat preview without opening the image. If you put your own quote on the picture, aim for the same length: the text is set smaller as it gets longer, and a paragraph becomes fine print on a phone.

sections.heading: Quote someone you know
body: The lines that mean most are rarely famous. Something a teacher, a coach or a grandparent used to say, typed onto a picture and sent to the family group, is more likely to be kept than a forwarded quotation. Open the picture, type the line under “Add a name or message”, and add who said it at the end if you like.
If you do use a famous quotation, check who actually said it before you put a name under it.

faq.q: Can I put my own quote on the picture?
faq.a: Yes. Type it under “Add a name or message” and it replaces the quote. You have up to 120 characters.

faq.q: Why is my long quote so small on the picture?
faq.a: The text is made smaller until it fits on four lines. Shorten the quote and it is set larger.

faq.q: Can I use a motivational image on Instagram or as a status?
faq.a: Yes. The picture is square, 1080 × 1080, so it can be posted as a WhatsApp status or a square Instagram post.

faq.q: Can I write the quote in Malayalam, Hindi or Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. Whatever you type is set as real text in that script.

pictures.title: Malayalam friends at a campfire
pictures.subtitle: എന്നും ഒരുമിച്ച്
pictures.description: നമ്മുടെ സൗഹൃദം (our friendship) over four friends at a campfire on a Kerala hill at dusk. A free Malayalam friends group DP for WhatsApp.
pictures.about: Four friends sit round a small campfire on a hillside at dusk, among coconut palms, with misty blue hills behind them. നമ്മുടെ സൗഹൃദം (our friendship) is set in the sky, with എന്നും ഒരുമിച്ച്, always together, underneath. Type your group's name in Malayalam or English to replace both lines.

pictures.title: Two bicycles side by side
pictures.description: Two old bicycles side by side on a country path among wildflowers in golden light, with “Better with you.” A free couple DP for WhatsApp.
pictures.about: Two old-fashioned bicycles, one with a wicker basket, stand side by side on a country path lined with wildflowers in soft golden light. “Better with you.” is set in the hazy sky above. Two bikes stand in for the two of you, so no faces are shown. Type your names or a date to replace the line.

pictures.title: Couple under an umbrella in the rain
pictures.description: A couple walking under one umbrella on a wet, misty road at dusk, seen from far behind, with “My forever person.” A free couple DP.
pictures.about: A couple share one umbrella as they walk away down a wet road in the rain, seen from far behind, with street lamps reflected on the shining road and mist all around. “My forever person.” is set in the blue-grey sky. Their faces cannot be seen. Type your names or an anniversary date to replace the line.

pictures.title: Heart hands at sunset
pictures.description: Two hands making a heart shape around the setting sun over the sea, with “Love you, always.” A free romantic couple DP for WhatsApp.
pictures.about: Two hands form a heart shape in front of the sea, framing the setting sun inside it, under an orange evening sky. “Love you, always.” is set above. Only the hands are shown. It is a romantic DP for a partner, or a status for an anniversary. Type both your names or a date to replace the line.

pictures.title: Lovebirds on a blossom branch
pictures.description: Two lovebirds sitting close together on a branch of white blossom, with “Just us two.” A cute couple DP for WhatsApp with no people in it.
pictures.about: Two small green lovebirds with peach-coloured faces sit pressed together on a branch of white spring blossom, against a soft cream background. “Just us two.” is set above them. It is a sweet, playful couple DP for those who would rather not show any people. Type your names to replace the line.

pictures.title: Red rose on a balcony at night
pictures.description: “Good night, my love.” over a single red rose on a wooden balcony rail under a starry night sky. A free romantic good night image for WhatsApp.
pictures.about: A single red rose lies on a wooden balcony rail at night, with warm light from the window below it and a deep blue starry sky above. “Good night, my love.” is set in the sky. It is meant for a partner, especially one who is far away. Type their name or your own words to replace the line.

pictures.title: Harbour at night
pictures.text:
Good night.
Sleep in God’s care.
pictures.h1: Good Night, Sleep in God’s Care Image
pictures.description: “Good night. Sleep in God’s care.” over small boats resting in a calm harbour under a starry sky. A free good night blessing image for WhatsApp.
pictures.about: Small boats lie at rest on the calm water of a harbour at night, with the lights of the shore and dark hills behind them under a starry sky. “Good night. Sleep in God’s care.” is set in the sky. It suits a parent, a grandparent or a prayer group. Type a name or your own blessing to replace the line.

pictures.title: Kerala home at night
pictures.description: “Good night, Amma.” over a tiled-roof Kerala house with an oil lamp lit at the doorstep under the stars. A free good night image for your mother.
pictures.about: A long tiled-roof Kerala house at night, a small oil lamp burning on the step by the open door and potted plants along the veranda, under a starry sky. “Good night, Amma.” is set in the sky above it. Send it to your mother, or type Achan, Ammachi or another name; your text replaces the line.

pictures.title: Psalm 121:3 good night verse
pictures.text:
He who watches
over you
will not slumber.
pictures.subtitle: Psalm 121:3
pictures.h1: Good Night Bible Verse Image: Psalm 121:3
pictures.description: “He who watches over you will not slumber.” Psalm 121:3 over a starry sky and a still mountain lake. A free good night Bible verse image.
pictures.about: Dark mountains stand over a perfectly still lake at night, with the stars of a deep blue sky reflected in the water. Psalm 121:3, “He who watches over you will not slumber.”, is set in the sky, with the reference underneath. For a different verse, type the words and the reference together; they replace both lines.

pictures.title: Isaiah 40:31 morning verse
pictures.text:
Those who hope
in the Lord will
renew their strength.
pictures.subtitle: Isaiah 40:31
pictures.h1: Good Morning Bible Verse Image: Isaiah 40:31
pictures.description: “Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.” Isaiah 40:31 over misty mountains at dawn. A free Christian good morning image.
pictures.about: Layers of misty mountains fade into a soft pink dawn sky, with a single bird gliding high on the right. Isaiah 40:31, “Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.”, is set across the sky, with the reference in small text below. It suits someone facing a tiring day. Type another verse with its reference to replace both lines.

pictures.title: John 8:12 morning verse
pictures.text:
I am the light
of the world.
pictures.subtitle: John 8:12
pictures.h1: Good Morning Bible Verse Image: John 8:12
pictures.description: “I am the light of the world.” John 8:12 over a white lighthouse on a rocky point at dawn. A free Christian good morning image for WhatsApp.
pictures.about: A small white lighthouse stands on a rocky point running out into a calm sea, in the pale blue and gold light of early morning. John 8:12, “I am the light of the world.”, is set in the sky, with the reference beneath it. It is a good fit for a church or prayer group. Type your own verse and reference to replace both lines.

pictures.title: Have a blessed day
pictures.text:
Good morning.
Have a blessed day.
pictures.h1: Good Morning, Have a Blessed Day Image
pictures.description: “Good morning. Have a blessed day.” over yellow and white daisies in a glass jar on a sunny window sill. A free blessing image for WhatsApp.
pictures.about: A glass jar of yellow and white daisies stands on a wooden window sill, with morning sun glowing through a pale cotton curtain behind it. “Good morning. Have a blessed day.” is set above the curtain. It is a gentle greeting for a family group or an older relative. Type a name or your own blessing to replace the line.

pictures.title: Psalm 118:24 in Malayalam
pictures.subtitle: സങ്കീർത്തനങ്ങൾ 118:24
pictures.h1: Malayalam Bible Verse Good Morning Image
pictures.description: ഇതു യഹോവ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ദിവസം, Psalm 118:24 in Malayalam, over Kerala paddy fields at sunrise. A free Malayalam Christian good morning image.
pictures.about: A path runs through green paddy fields towards a line of coconut palms in the morning mist, under a soft golden sunrise. Psalm 118:24 in Malayalam, ഇതു യഹോവ ഉണ്ടാക്കിയ ദിവസം (this is the day the Lord has made), is set in the sky, with സങ്കീർത്തനങ്ങൾ 118:24 underneath. Type your own verse in Malayalam or English to replace both lines.

pictures.title: Chocolate cake with sparklers
pictures.description: “Happy Birthday!” over a chocolate cake with sparklers and warm fairy lights. A free birthday image; type their name to make it a wish with name.
pictures.about: A round chocolate cake on a wooden table with two sparklers burning on top, and a string of warm fairy lights glowing in the dark behind it. “Happy Birthday!” is set above the lights. Type the whole wish with their name, such as “Happy Birthday, Anu!”, and it replaces the greeting.

pictures.title: Gifts and confetti
pictures.description: “Happy Birthday, dear friend.” over three wrapped gifts with bright ribbons and confetti on a pink background. A free birthday image for a friend.
pictures.about: Three wrapped gift boxes with bright ribbons sit on a white table scattered with confetti, against a soft pink wall. “Happy Birthday, dear friend.” is set above them. Send it as it is, or type your friend's name into the wish; your text replaces the whole line, so write all of it.

pictures.title: Roses and balloons for Amma
pictures.description: “Happy Birthday, Amma.” over a bouquet of pink roses and white lilies with pastel balloons. A free birthday image to send to your mother.
pictures.about: A bouquet of pink roses and white lilies lies on a wooden table beside pastel blue, pink and yellow balloons, in soft daylight. “Happy Birthday, Amma.” is set above. Send it to your mother as it is, or type Mummy, Ammachi or her name; your text replaces the line.

pictures.title: Row of birthday cupcakes
pictures.text:
Many happy returns
of the day.
pictures.h1: Many Happy Returns of the Day Image
pictures.description: “Many happy returns of the day.” over a row of cupcakes with sprinkles and lit candles. A free birthday image for WhatsApp; add their name.
pictures.about: A row of cupcakes with white frosting and rainbow sprinkles, each with one lit candle, on a white table against a pale mint background. “Many happy returns of the day.” is set above them. It is the classic greeting that older relatives often send. Type the wish with a name to replace the line.

pictures.title: Tea hills at sunrise
pictures.subtitle: ഒരു നല്ല ദിവസം ആശംസിക്കുന്നു
pictures.h1: Suprabhatham Image: Tea Hills at Sunrise
pictures.description: സുപ്രഭാതം over green tea hills at sunrise, with ഒരു നല്ല ദിവസം ആശംസിക്കുന്നു (wishing you a good day). A free Malayalam good morning image.
pictures.about: Rolling tea hills in neat green rows, with mist in the valleys and the sun rising over the far ridge. സുപ്രഭാതം (good morning) is set in the sky, with ഒരു നല്ല ദിവസം ആശംസിക്കുന്നു, wishing you a good day, underneath. Type your own words in Malayalam or English to replace both lines.

pictures.title: Jasmine in morning light
pictures.subtitle: ചിരിയോടെ തുടങ്ങാം
pictures.description: ശുഭദിനം with ചിരിയോടെ തുടങ്ങാം (let's start with a smile) over white jasmine flowers in soft morning light. A free Malayalam good morning image.
pictures.about: White jasmine flowers and buds in soft morning light, against a pale green and cream background. ശുഭദിനം (have a good day) is set above them, with ചിരിയോടെ തുടങ്ങാം, let's start with a smile, underneath. Jasmine is a familiar morning flower in Kerala homes. Type your own words in Malayalam or English to replace both lines.
